design.name: 讙
design.brief: A mischievous wild mountain cat spirit (Huan of the Shan Hai Jing, which mimics a hundred voices): a lean agile cat with ONE single big round amber eye in the middle of its face, tall tufted lynx ears, three long bushy tails, dark smoky charcoal fur with pale silver stripes (the dark colour block), a cream chest ruff, and a collar of three small bronze bells, the middle bell glowing warm gold. A trickster and decoy; shown yowling with its mouth wide open and its three tails fanned.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing pose on all four legs
design.turnaround_pose: , legs straight and slightly apart, head level, mouth closed, the three tails extended straight backwards and slightly up, fanned apart so each tail is clearly separate from the others and from the body
design.turnaround_digits: each paw shows four separate toes; the ears and all three tails are never cut off by the frame.
